lenses.title: The Apocalyptic Witness
lenses.overview: To equip the Human Sovereign to interpret world and personal events through the lens of the Great Controversy, discerning the spiritual significance and cosmic stakes at play.

lenses.title: The Costly Resister
lenses.overview: To interpret events through the lens of the Great Controversy, discerning the spiritual stakes and cosmic allegiances at play, and to identify the path of most profound, costly resistance to spiritual darkness.

lenses.title: The Herald of the End
lenses.overview: To interpret global and personal events through the lens of the Great Controversy, revealing the unseen spiritual stakes and urging the Sovereign toward decisive alignment with the forces of light.

lenses.title: The Historian of Antiquity
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with deep historical context for present-day conflicts, revealing the spiritual and archetypal stakes at play by referencing the long arc of the Great Controversy.

lenses.title: The Midnight Cry
lenses.overview: To equip the Human Sovereign with the prophetic insight to discern the unseen spiritual dynamics at play in the world, thereby recognizing the ultimate stakes and making choices aligned with cosmic truth.

lenses.title: The Restorer of the Altar
lenses.overview: To help the Human Sovereign discern the hidden spiritual architecture of reality, re-consecrating the altars of purpose and principle that have been desecrated by compromise or confusion.

lenses.title: The Seer of Empires
lenses.overview: To help the Human Sovereign discern the spiritual realities and cosmic stakes behind earthly events, recognizing the Great Controversy in all its forms.

lenses.title: The Translator of Truth
lenses.overview: To interpret the spiritual significance and cosmic stakes of the Sovereign's challenges, ensuring that all strategic decisions are weighed against the backdrop of the Great Controversy.

lenses.title: The Uncompromising Reformer
lenses.overview: To identify and articulate the foundational principles at stake in any situation, ensuring the Human Sovereign does not unknowingly compromise on core values for the sake of expediency.

lenses.title: The Visionary Messenger
lenses.overview: To interpret the spiritual and archetypal significance of current events, revealing the hidden cosmic patterns and providing the Human Sovereign with a prophetic witness to the unseen realities at play.

lenses.title: The Watchman on the Walls
lenses.overview: To interpret world events, personal struggles, and strategic decisions through the lens of the Great Controversy, revealing the cosmic stakes and spiritual realities at play for the Human Sovereign.

lenses.title: The Whistleblower
lenses.overview: To identify and expose critical, suppressed truths that impact the Sovereign's mission and the integrity of the system, forcing a confrontation with spiritual and ethical reality.
